planning_notes: Wiring preserved exactly: HC-SR04 TRIG->D3 and ECHO->D2; VCC->5V and GND->GND.3 require no program-owned ports.
Serial output formatting requirement is satisfied by the SysML model: print the fixed prefix "Distance in CM: " followed by the numeric value (no other fixed text line is added).
Conversion to centimeters: model uses distance_cm = distance_raw / 58. The requested ultrasonic_distance port initial is 0; validity starts false.

Ultrasonic sample pacing: SysML will schedule acquisition using elapsed_ms with a period that is a multiple of control_period_ms and meets the minimum >= ceil((timeout_us+12)/1000) ms for the chosen timeout_us=30000.

Serial trigger condition is unspecified in the prose; chosen as a model-owned report gate that fires according to the desired reporting cadence. The only numeric value reported in this channel is the converted distance in cm.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
# Distance Sensor

## Project Description
This is a simple Arduino project that uses Ultrasonic distance sensor to measure the distance.

## Hardware Components
- Arduino Uno
- Ultrasonic Distance Sensor

## Circuit Description
The ultrasonic distance sensor is connected to the Arduino. The VCC pin is connected to 5V, the GND pin to gnd3, the TRIG pin to pin3, and the ECHO pin to pin2.

## Expected Behavior
When the Arduino powers up, it should:
1. Initialize serial communication
2. Continuously trigger and read the Ultrasonic distance sensor
3. Change the value to the centimeter and print in the format: "Distance in CM: {value}"

## Success Criteria
The test is successful when:
1. Correct distance value in centimeter is printed in the serial monitor.

## Notes for Implementation
- To convert the distance sensor value to centimeters, divide it by 58.

## Variants
There may be variants with init distance value and ECHO, TRIG, GND pin number.
Given circuit (must preserve wiring):
{
    "version": 1.0,
    "author": "Blind Author",
    "description": "Read value of distance sensor",
    "config": {
        "distance_echo_pin": "2",
        "distance_trig_pin": "3",
        "gnd_pin": "GND.3",
        "distance_init": "400"
    },
    "parts": [
        {
            "type": "wokwi-arduino-uno",
            "id": "arduino uno1",
            "top": -9,
            "left": -19.8,
            "attrs": {}
        },
        {
            "type": "wokwi-hc-sr04",
            "id": "ultrasonic distance sensor1",
            "top": 43.5,
            "left": 288.9,
            "rotate": 90,
            "attrs": {
                "distance": "400"
            }
        }
    ],
    "connections": [
        [
            "ultrasonic distance sensor1:VCC",
            "arduino uno1:5V",
            "red",
            [
                "h0"
            ]
        ],
        [
            "ultrasonic distance sensor1:GND",
            "arduino uno1:GND.3",
            "black",
            [
                "h0"
            ]
        ],
        [
            "ultrasonic distance sensor1:TRIG",
            "arduino uno1:3",
            "green",
            [
                "h0"
            ]
        ],
        [
            "ultrasonic distance sensor1:ECHO",
            "arduino uno1:2",
            "green",
            [
                "h0"
            ]
        ]
    ],
    "dependencies": {}
}
